rpghealthbar.config.title: RPG Health Bar
rpghealthbar.edit.title: Move HUD
rpghealthbar.edit.hint: Drag the HUD to move it. Arrow keys nudge (Shift: 10px).
rpghealthbar.config.healthUnit.tooltip: Unit for the numbers on the health bar.
rpghealthbar.config.absorptionDisplay.to: How absorption (golden hearts) is shown. Example: 16 HP of health, 4 HP of absorption (2 golden hearts), 20 HP max.
rpghealthbar.config.moveHud.tooltip: Drag the bars, XP bar and level number to a new spot as one group, then Save. Arrow keys nudge it.
rpghealthbar.config.resetPosition.toolti: Move the HUD back to its default spot above the hotbar, with every piece back in place.
rpghealthbar.config.armorMode.tooltip.va: the normal armor icons, in the row above the health bar.
rpghealthbar.config.armorMode.tooltip.ba: a white bar, half the width of the health bar.
rpghealthbar.config.hungerMode.tooltip.v: the normal hunger icons, in the row above the health bar.
rpghealthbar.config.hungerMode.tooltip.b: an orange bar, half the width of the health bar.
rpghealthbar.config.healthUnit.tooltip.h: health points, 20 for a full vanilla health bar.
HP divided by 2, so 10 for a full vanilla health bar.
rpghealthbar.config.showHealthText.toolt: Whether the numbers are written on the health bar.
shows e.g. 16+4/20 on the left of the bar.
rpghealthbar.config.showManaText.tooltip: Whether the numbers are written on the mana bar (only shown with Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks).
shows e.g. 60/100 on the left of the bar.
rpghealthbar.edit.hint.one: Drag a piece to move it on its own. Arrow keys nudge it (Shift: 10px).
rpghealthbar.config.moveMode.tooltip.all: The whole HUD, with every piece keeping its place in it.
rpghealthbar.config.moveMode.tooltip.one: One piece on its own: armor, hunger, health, mana, or the XP bar with the level. Air bubbles and mount health move with hunger.
